methodDefinition: score=1-p(label); quantile rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); infinity if rank>n; include all boundary ties; no random tie breaking

choice.question: Route a bounded issue to bug, docs, or feature

noul.question: Does a bounded change require review?

generation: Independent PRNG streams; 70% easy, 20% tied, 10% rare-class examples. Quantized probabilities; held-out labels drawn from nominal categorical distribution. Shift draws labels from reversed class distribution with unchanged predictions. IDs include task and split; entities unique.
sampleRationale: 600 test rows gives nominal 90% coverage about +/-2.4 percentage points at 95%; class/slice results below 50 are descriptive only. Synthetic n does not meet the representative-data requirement.
baselines: raw primitive policy: Choice selected probability >=0.8, Noul yes probability <=0.2 or >=0.8
calibrated risk: tuning top-probability decile empirical error with Wilson upper bound <=0.1, evaluated by existing primitive policy; missing bins review
loss: 0-1 classification loss; false-auto=wrong singleton / all rows; selective-risk=wrong singleton / singleton rows; review cost=review rows (unit cost)
metrics: marginal and class/slice set coverage with Wilson intervals
mean p50 p90 p95 set size
outcomeRule: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE when representative frozen D11 workflow data or approved calibrated profiles are missing; synthetic arithmetic cannot establish GO. No Score study without ordinal loss validation. No production routing or policy mutations.
lifecycle: Only generated public synthetic records supported. Restricted, deleted, held, non-active, OOD, provider-backed, or compatibility one-hot records rejected before evaluation. No credential or network access. Live absence is recorded, never counted as offline success.
